editorial: In the software world today, AI-focused tools built on both browser automation and long-term memory architectures are coming to the fore. Curation projects from the Hacker News community, along with new language models like DeepSeek and Liquid AI, continue to attract the attention of developers.

items.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.summary: thedotmack/claude-mem is a TypeScript project that allows AI agents to maintain persistent context across sessions. By compressing and saving the actions performed by the agent and transferring relevant information to subsequent sessions, this tool works compatibly with various coding assistants such as Claude Code and Copilot.

snapshot.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

items.title: lightpanda-io/browser
items.summary: Lightpanda is a headless browser written in the Zig language, specifically developed for AI and automation processes. Designed to process real web pages over the network, this tool targets workflows that require high-performance web interaction.

snapshot.description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation. Requesting 933 real web pages over the network on a AWS EC2 m5.large instance. See benchmark details.

items.title: shiyu-coder/Kronos
items.summary: shiyu-coder/Kronos is a family of foundation models developed to analyze the unique K-line sequences of financial markets. Unlike general-purpose time series models, it uses a two-stage framework to manage the high noise levels in financial data.

snapshot.description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets. Kronos is a family of decoder-only foundation models, pre-trained specifically for the "language" of financial markets—K-line sequences. Unlike general-purpose TSFMs, Kronos is designed to handle the unique, high-noise characteristics of financial data. It leverages a novel two-stage framework: 1.

items.title: pingdotgg/t3code
items.summary: T3 Code offers an agent harness control surface that allows you to manage AI agents running on your computer. Through this tool, users can control agents via mobile applications, a web interface, and an Electron-based desktop application.

snapshot.description: T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface". It enables control of the agents on your machine with a best-in-class mobile app (iOS, Android), web app and Electron-based desktop app.

items.title: milind-soni/OpenMausBot
items.summary: OpenMausBot is an open-source Grok Bot alternative that allows you to create your own team of AI bots within chat applications. The system provides a virtual machine infrastructure that the bots can utilize.

snapshot.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use. The open-source Grok Bot alternative: your own team of AI bots, in a chat app.

items.title: public-apis/public-apis
items.summary: public-apis provides a comprehensive list of free application programming interfaces (APIs) that software developers can use in their projects. APILayer, on the other hand, provides access to production-level REST API services through a single account and key.

snapshot.description: A collective list of free APIs. APILayer unified suite allows you to integrate production-grade REST APIs using One Account, One Dashboard, and One API key. Whether you need to geocode an address, validate an email, fetch a flight, pull stock market data, or scrape a search result.

items.title: cjpais/Handy
items.summary: cjpais/Handy is a free and open-source speech-to-text application that works entirely offline. Developed in the Rust language, this tool offers an extensible structure, allowing users to process voice data in a local environment.

snapshot.description: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline. A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.

items.title: Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios
items.summary: Claude-Code-Game-Studios transforms the Claude Code software into a full-fledged game development studio with 49 AI agents and 72 workflow skills. It aims to automate game production processes with a coordination system that reflects a real studio hierarchy.

snapshot.description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.

items.title: kornia/kornia
items.summary: Kornia is a differentiable computer vision library developed for spatial AI applications. Running on the PyTorch deep learning framework, this tool enables the integration of image processing and geometric vision algorithms into AI workflows.

snapshot.description: 🐍 Geometric Computer Vision Library for Spatial AI. Kornia is a differentiable computer vision library that provides a rich set of differentiable image processing and geometric vision algorithms. Built on top of PyTorch, Kornia integrates seamlessly into existing AI workflows, allowing you to leverage powerful batch transformations, auto-differentiation and GPU acceleration.

items.title: beenuar/AiSOC
items.summary: AiSOC is an open-source AI security center developed to automate security operations. The tool, which classifies alerts using large language models (LLMs) and conducts investigations with the MITRE ATT&CK framework, can run on your own server without requiring an API key.

snapshot.description: Open-source AI Security Operations Center: alert fusion, LLM-agent triage, MITRE ATT&CK investigation, and a replayable decision ledger for every agent step. Self-hostable, runs with no API keys, MIT licensed. Ships an MCP server for Claude, Cursor and Continue.

items.title: Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu
items.summary: Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu is an open-source astrological charting engine based on Ni Hai-Xia's Tian Ji system. The software provides a large 13-dimensional interpretation dataset covering dates between 1950 and 2026, along with a comprehensive library of astrological knowledge, all in the TypeScript language.

snapshot.description: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎 — 基于倪海厦《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据. 1. 发布 13 维解读数据集 v4.0 —— 674,976 张命盘（公历 1950–2026 年每一个真实日期 × 12 时辰 × 男女）× 13 维 = 8,774,688 段解读，正文约 204 亿字。解压后 56.6 GB（v3.0 为 33.1 GB，增加 71%），压缩后只有 161 MB，按年份分 77 个文件，可以只下需要的年份，也可以一次下全年份总包。下载见 Release v4.0-13d，规格和字段见第二·新章。发布前 77 个文件逐个解压，与原始数据逐字节比对一致。

items.title: anomalyco/hex
items.summary: Developed in Rust, Hex is a native voice dictation tool that runs on Mac, Windows, and Linux operating systems. It allows users to speak by holding down a key and converts their speech into text.

snapshot.description: Local voice dictation for mac, windows and linux. Hex is local voice dictation for Mac, Windows and Linux. Hold a key, speak, and it pastes.

items.title: CopilotKit/OpenBot
items.summary: CopilotKit/OpenBot offers open-source AI coworkers with access to browsers, files, and tools. This system, where every action is predefined and recorded, allows for the integration of different user interface agents (AG-UI agents).

snapshot.description: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own: a browser, files and tools, with every action decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent.

items.title: patchy631/ai-engineering-hub
items.summary: patchy631/ai-engineering-hub provides in-depth tutorials on Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and real-world AI agent applications. Prepared in Jupyter Notebook format, this resource serves as a comprehensive learning hub for those looking to develop AI-based systems.

snapshot.description: In-depth tutorials on LLMs, RAGs and real-world AI agent applications. Welcome to the AI Engineering Hub - your comprehensive resource for learning and building with AI!

items.title: FlashML-org/FreeToken
items.summary: FlashML-org/FreeToken is a library that enables running data-center-scale large AI models on personal computers quickly and efficiently. It allows users to run Mixture of Experts (MoE) models with over 290 billion parameters on standard hardware at interactive speeds.

snapshot.description: FreeToken brings datacenter-scale model serving to your desktop. Run massive models locally, fast and efficiently. Unlock datacenter-class intelligence on the hardware you already own — Run 290B+ frontier MoE models locally on your gaming PC at blistering interactive speeds.

items.title: hyprwm/Hyprland
items.summary: Hyprland is a highly customizable dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that does not compromise on visual aesthetics. Developed in C++, this standalone software allows users to configure their desktop environments according to their own preferences.

snapshot.description: Hyprland is an independent, highly customizable, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks. Hyprland is a 100% independent, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks.

items.title: HackerTube: YouTube built from videos recommended by HN
items.summary: HackerTube presents 6,454 videos shared in Hacker News comments since 2007 through a YouTube-like interface. It aggregates content recommended on the technology-focused discussion platform Hacker News in a single location.

snapshot.description: YouTube-style UI over 6,454 videos sourced from 39,834 HN comments since 2007.https://hackertube.org/

items.title: Show HN: HackerBooks – HackerTube, but for books mentioned on HN
items.summary: HackerBooks is a platform that lists approximately 16,500 books recommended by at least two different users on the Hacker News platform. This project, which allows users to directly access comments made about the books, was developed using Claude Opus 5.5.

snapshot.description: Saw Karpathy's HackerTube and wanted the same thing for books. So I had Claude build one (Opus 5.5).It's ~16.5k books that at least two different HN commenters brought up, from 2007 till now. Each book links back to the comments that mentioned it. Data is downloadable from the about page.T

items.title: Lenovo's 'encrypted' fingerprint USB is just an unencrypted SD card in a case
items.summary: It has been revealed that the fingerprint-reading USB drive, which Lenovo claimed was encrypted, actually consists of an unencrypted SD card placed inside a casing. This situation shows that the security features offered by the product do not reflect reality.

items.title: The AI cost of JavaScript frameworks
items.summary: The performance costs created by JavaScript frameworks in web development processes are being discussed alongside the impact of AI tools on this ecosystem. It is criticized that developers make technical decisions based on general opinions rather than data-driven analyses.

snapshot.description: One of my pet peeves with the web development community is that so many of the decisions we make are vibes-based. Frameworks are “blazing fast,” tools will…

items.title: Mathematics has changed. Let's act like it
items.summary: The transformation that the discipline of mathematics is undergoing with the development of AI tools reveals that working methods in this field need to be updated. The article written by Frank Calegari evaluates the effects of new technologies announced by OpenAI on mathematical processes and calls for adaptation to change.

snapshot.description: [This is a guest post by Frank Calegari. This blog post was initially written in a different file format and converted using AI. — T.] Why we should not be sad The release by OpenAI on Octobe…

items.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
items.summary: Published on Hugging Face, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is an AI model capable of processing visual and text-based data. While offering improvements in areas such as reasoning, coding, and visual analysis compared to the previous version, it aims to reduce processing time and costs.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, delivering substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks. Alongside these gains, the model reduces task execution time and output length, enabling users to complete tasks faster and at lower cost and advancing the performance–cost Pareto frontier across multiple agent harnesses.

items.title: LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B
items.summary: Developed by LiquidAI, LFM3-1.7B is a text-generation model designed for local agents and specialized applications. Built on a new tri-hybrid architecture, this model stands out with its compact structure.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. LFM3-1.7B is a text model for local agents and specialized applications, based on our new tri-hybrid architecture.

items.title: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B
items.summary: Developed by NVIDIA, NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B is an open-weight automatic speech recognition model capable of transcribing in 40 languages. Operating with a mixture-of-experts architecture, the model can process audio recordings of up to one hour with a 65,536-token context window.

snapshot.description: automatic-speech-recognition model. Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open-weight, offline speech and audio model for transcription in 40 languages, with support for recordings up to one hour and a 65,536-token context. Its hybrid mixture-of-experts architecture activates approximately 4.3B parameters, including the audio encoder, and it is released in BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 precision.

items.title: mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B
items.summary: Mistral Large 4-1T-A52B is a multimodal AI model shared on Hugging Face that can process both visual and text inputs. Featuring a one-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts architecture, this model uses 49 billion active parameters per token.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Mistral Large 4 is our largest and most capable model to date: a 1 trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 49 billion active parameters per token (52 billion including embeddings and output layers), trained from scratch on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own datacenters in Europe.

items.title: baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2
items.summary: Developed by Baidu, Unlimited-OCR-2 is an AI model that processes image-based text and converts it into text. Offering image-to-text conversion capabilities, this model is designed to work compatibly with Python-based libraries.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Tested with Python 3.10, torch==2.13.0, transformers==4.52.1, huggingface-hub==0.36.0, tokenizers==0.21.4, on an NVIDIA A800-80GB:

items.title: HALO: Human-Grounded Granular Evaluation of Proactive Agents
items.summary: HALO, shared by Hugging Face, is a human-centric method developed to evaluate the processes by which proactive agents assist users without an explicit request. This study aims to analyze the intervention quality and evidence usage of agents in detail across four different types of needs.

snapshot.description: Proactive agents must decide whether, when, and how far to assist without an explicit request. Existing evaluations often rely on automated scores or binary verdicts, offering limited human diagnosis of evidence use and intervention quality. To address these gaps, we introduce HALO, Human-Grounded GrAnular EvaLuation of PrOactive Agents. HALO-Arena covers 4 proactive need types, Dependency, Blockage, Risk, and Opportunity, across 10 everyday domains and 50 personal environments. Scenarios requir

items.title: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use
items.summary: Apriel Voice 27B Preview, shared on Hugging Face, is an open-source voice assistant that combines speech recognition, reasoning, and tool-use capabilities into a single AI model. Developed based on Gemma 4 26B-A4B, the model supports text and visual inputs while being capable of direct audio processing and tool calling.

snapshot.description: A capable voice assistant must do more than recognize words; it must understand requests, reason over context, sustain conversations, and act through tools. We present Apriel Voice 27B Preview, an open speech-language model that unifies these capabilities within a shared reasoning backbone while retaining text and image input modalities. Built on the post-trained Gemma 4 26B-A4B checkpoint, Apriel Voice directly processes speech and generates both responses and tool calls without requiring a sep

items.title: Probing Spatial State Representations in Visual Foundation Models
items.summary: The paper 'Probing Spatial State Representations in Visual Foundation Models', shared on Hugging Face, examines the ability of visual foundation models to perceive the environment and maintain spatial continuity. The study evaluates the level of representation models provide regarding object permanence and predictive spatial updating across four different capability levels.

snapshot.description: An observer sees only part of the surrounding world, yet must keep track of what lies beyond the current view. Spatial perception therefore involves more than recognizing individual images: it calls for a persistent spatial state that is updated under self-motion and used to guide action. Do visual foundation models provide representations that support such a state? We study this question through four levels of spatial capability---spatial structure, object persistence, predictive spatial update

items.title: On the Origin and Evolution of Training-Inference Mismatch in LLM Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: The paper published on Hugging Face examines the discrepancy that occurs between training and inference stages in the reinforcement learning processes of large language models (LLMs). Stating that this situation arises from weight staleness caused by numerical differences and asynchronous sampling, the study emphasizes that existing correction methods may be insufficient to solve both problems.

snapshot.description: On-policy reinforcement learning for large language models assumes that training responses are sampled from the current policy. In practice, an inference engine samples the responses and a separate trainer computes the gradients, and the training-inference mismatch between the two makes the training data off-policy. items.title: CaPtain: A Pipeline for Post-Training Code-as-Policy Robot Agents
items.summary: CaPtain offers a training pipeline that combines robotic manipulation tasks with the code-writing process. This method uses supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning processes for AI agents that enable robots to perform operations by writing code via application programming interfaces (APIs).

snapshot.description: Across coding, web, and tool-use tasks, language-model agents are now routinely trained with the same recipe: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to learn the interface, then multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) to master it. Code-as-policy (CaP) casts robot manipulation in the same form, as the policy writes code against robot APIs and reads back the results, so the same recipe should apply. Yet existing CaP agents sidestep training: they either prompt closed frontier models or delegate manipulation

glossary.explanation: A persistent data storage method that allows AI agents to remember information across different sessions.

AI models with foundational capabilities trained on massive amounts of data to be used in a wide variety of tasks.
A central management dashboard that enables the management and supervision of AI agents running on a computer.
A type of software whose source code is open for anyone to access, inspect, and improve.
A software-based computer environment that runs its own operating system using the resources of a physical computer.
A connection point that allows different software applications to exchange data and communicate with each other.
Technology that detects spoken conversations and converts them into written text.
Specialized capabilities and task definitions used by artificial intelligence agents to complete specific business processes.
A branch of artificial intelligence that perceives and interprets the position of objects and the environment in the three-dimensional world.
Technology that enables computers to analyze digital images and videos to derive meaningful results.
Artificial intelligence models trained on massive amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.
The process of displaying data or astrological information on a visual diagram or map.
A type of software whose source code is open for anyone to access, inspect, and improve.
Artificial intelligence software capable of performing operations on user interfaces and interacting with the interface.
A technique that allows artificial intelligence models to scan and use up-to-date information from external sources in addition to their own data when generating answers.
